CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2823 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head c4923cc0873bbfa3bd339a3c3bbdbae77b3539df. Bus nonce: 9e73ee6c7c47b8aa32b81ac9908df445. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin c4923cc0873bbfa3bd339a3c3bbdbae77b3539df`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge c4923cc0873bbfa3bd339a3c3bbdbae77b3539df` or `Fix review: blocked c4923cc0873bbfa3bd339a3c3bbdbae77b3539df <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 9e73ee6c7c47b8aa32b81ac9908df445`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `c4923cc0873bbfa3bd339a3c3bbdbae77b3539df` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2823 c4923cc0873bbfa3bd339a3c3bbdbae77b3539df") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2823-9e73ee6c`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA review of #2823 (roster batch 14) against dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md, at the new head. Round 1 (head f6f67ede) was blocked because commit 1ac59f510 carried the R10-HEAT-METER design's clamp-reset ruling to R10-RATIO-ANCHOR, a done group (review comment 6400897868). Round 2 adds five roster commits (709ee1929 is the roster tip): df2ec9daa appends that ruling to R10-HEAT-METER, 1ee87a2ee drops it from R10-RATIO-ANCHOR, ec736473f appends the group R10-PLAN-ISSUES-CHART, 4aa0123eb appends its seam carry to R10-ORCH-PLANPAGE, and 709ee1929 adds R10-PLAN-ISSUES-CHART to R10-ARCH-DOCS' `after`. The pull request changes only dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json and its delivery row. Check:
- the original block is fixed: run tools/audit/carry_audit.py on the body at this head, and confirm every carry destination exists on main's roster and is not done or absorbed; R10-RATIO-ANCHOR must be unchanged against main (the ruling's text is on R10-HEAT-METER, none left on RATIO-ANCHOR).
- re-derive the body's figures at this head: `git log --no-merges --reverse --format='%h %s' 9442cb4ea..709ee1929 -- dev/programme/rosters/` prints 30 commits; groups main 190, head 192 (new R10-LEGIONELLA-COMPLETION and R10-PLAN-ISSUES-CHART), 18 changed groups with their carry deltas (R10-HEAT-METER 10->14, R10-ORCH-PLANPAGE 5->6), stage counts, the blob hashes, the diff stat (150 lines, 124 insertions, 26 deletions) and that no file but the roster JSON and the row changes.
- `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs` on the merged tree prints 0 errors; `node tools/policy/figure_lint.mjs --pr-body` refuses nothing; no carry text names a host or home path.
- the new group R10-PLAN-ISSUES-CHART: its fields, its lane, size and issues, that it lands first on plan_page.py and R10-ORCH-PLANPAGE's seam carry says so, and that the roster seat's queue lines 335-339 are what the diff holds.
Report merge or blocked.
